create_NemotronHConfig: create a NemotronHConfig instance with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
build_hybrid_pattern_config: build a NemotronHConfig with a custom hybrid_override_pattern specifying Mamba, Attention, and MLP layer order
test_layers_block_type: test the NemotronHConfig layers_block_type property to get the layer type for each hidden layer
configure_moe_experts: configure a NemotronHConfig with Mixture-of-Experts settings including n_routed_experts and num_experts_per_tok
setup_mamba_parameters: setup a NemotronHConfig with Mamba2 mixer parameters including ssm_state_size, mamba_head_dim, and chunk_size
